name: Rita Erland
source:
She is a virtuous, pure and innocent princess.  She strongly believes that “a noble must do her duty,” and from her early childhood, she has taken the initiative in being taught to be a priestess. 

She often gives priority to serving her people as a priestess over her position as a princess, which annoys her aides every time she does so. 

While she is a strict disciplinarian herself, she is also tolerant of others and treats everyone with respect.  Because of her personality, she is respected as a saint by her subordinates and the people.

[From [url=https://frill.product.co.jp/frill03/chara.html]official site[/url]]
